# Cittasambhūtajātaka (Ja 498)

**ID:** Ja 498
**Section:** Jātaka (ja)
**Collection:** Suttas-Late-1
**Title (Pali):** Cittasambhūtajātaka
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0513m.mul14.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Cittasambhūtajātaka* (Ja 498) is a canonical Jātaka narrative set at Jetavana concerning two affectionate co-residents (fellow-monks) under Mahākassapa whose inseparable friendship prompted the Buddha to explain that their bond endured across several past existences, opening with the verse beginning *sabbaṁ narānaṁ saphalaṁ suciṇṇaṁ* ("Every good deed") [Fausböll 1887]. Along with the *Mātaṅgajātaka* (Ja 497), modern scholarship situates the text within the genre of early "ascetic poetry," which contrasts the piety and self-control of the wandering ascetic against the formal ceremonialism of brahmans [Norman 1983]. Both stories possess direct counterparts in Jain canonical literature, demonstrating their age; while their close similarities point to a shared ancestral tradition, notable divergences demonstrate that the Buddhist and Jain lineages were independently redacted over time [Norman 1983].

 Machine alignments via DharmaNexus corroborate several of these connections, showing shared passages with the *Devaputta Saṁyutta* (SN 2) and the *Devatā Saṁyutta* (SN 1), as well as internal reuse in the *Mūgapakkhajātaka* (Ja 538) and extensive quotation in the *Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also records cross-language matches with the Sanskrit *Udānavarga* and Tibetan versions of the *Rājāvavādaka* and *Tridharmaka* sūtras [DharmaNexus].

**Parallels and text reuse**

- Passage-level parallels: DN 19 (PTS DN ii 220) Mahāgovinda Sutta; Ja 509 Hatthipālajātaka
- Resembling parallels: AN 3.51 Paṭhamadvebrāhmaṇasutta; SN 2.19 Uttarasutta; SN 1.3 Upanīyasutta; G3-Dhp 31–40 Gāndhārī 3rd Dharmapada Verses 31–40
- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā (Catuttho bhāgo) (Atk S0513a4) (§11.1–16.4 ↔ §3967–3985); Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā (Chaṭṭho bhāgo) (Atk S0514a2) (§13.1–14.4 ↔ §472–476); Mūgapakkhajātaka (Ja 538) (§13.1–14.4 ↔ §116.4–118.4); Devaputta Saṁyutta (SN 2) (§16.4–18.2 ↔ §19.1.2–19.3.2); Devatā Saṁyutta (SN 1) (§17.4–19.2 ↔ §3.1.2–3.3.2)
- Cross-language matches (DharmaNexus): Udānavarga (SA_K10_udanav_u) [sa]; འཕགས་པ་རྒྱལ་པོ་ལ་གདམས་པ་ཞེས་བྱ་བ་ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་མདོ། (ārya-rājāvavādaka-nāma-mahāyāna-sūtra) (D0221) [bo]; ཆོས་གསུམ་པ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་མདོ། (tridharmaka-nāma-sūtra) (D0253) [bo]
